sections.title: About
sections.body:
I work in audit and assurance in Dhaka, where I examine evidence, trace financial information to source documents, and turn findings into clear, well-supported conclusions. The work has shaped how I approach problems: ask thoughtful questions, pay attention to detail, and let the evidence guide the answer.

Alongside my professional work, I am pursuing the Chartered Accountancy qualification with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh (ICAB). I am also a co-founder of a technology business, exploring a different side of problem-solving through building and entrepreneurship.

Across audit, study, and business, the common thread is curiosity and a habit of checking that things add up. I am interested in how sound financial judgment and technology can help businesses make better decisions.

sections.title: Professional Experience
sections.body:
- Audit execution: Contributing to engagement planning, fieldwork, and reporting, with clear documentation of procedures, evidence, and conclusions.
- Financial statement auditing: Testing revenue, receivables, inventory, payroll, payables, operating expenses, and equity.
- Evidence & analysis: Tracing balances to supporting records, analysing financial data, and investigating discrepancies.
- Reporting & compliance: Reviewing accounting treatments and disclosures against applicable standards and regulatory requirements.
- Audit technology: Using Deloitte Omnia, Levvia, and advanced Excel for audit testing, data analysis, and documentation.

sections.title: What I work on
sections.body:
- Audit & assurance: Planning and carrying out audit engagements, evaluating evidence, and reporting findings with clear documentation that another reviewer can follow.
- Regulatory compliance: Assessing compliance with Bangladeshi laws and regulations, including requirements for NGOs and foreign donations.
- Financial reporting: Applying accounting standards and company law to assess financial balances, presentation, and disclosures.
- Data analytics & AI: Using data tools and AI to expand audit testing, identify unusual patterns, and reduce repetitive work.
- Internal controls & risk: Reviewing business processes, identifying control gaps, and recommending practical improvements.
- Financial analysis: Analysing balances, transactions, and trends to understand business performance and investigate inconsistencies.
- Technology & entrepreneurship: Co-founding a technology business and contributing to business planning, operations, and problem-solving.

sections.title: Education & Professional Development
sections.body:
- Academic education: BBA in Accounting & Information Systems (AIS) from Jagannath University.
- Professional qualification: Pursuing Chartered Accountancy with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Bangladesh (ICAB), currently at the Professional Level.
- Professional development: Building knowledge in financial reporting, assurance, and data analytics, with an interest in responsible AI and technology adoption in accounting and audit.

sections.title: Projects & Entrepreneurship
sections.body:
- Tickydo Ticketing: Co-founder of a digital ticketing and smart bus-counter platform, currently in pilot operations. [tickydo.com](https://tickydo.com)
- Tickydo ERP: Developing finance and accounting software for maintaining accounting records, managing the general ledger, and preparing financial reports.
